statement_map.email_excerpt: Following our guidance, you deleted the old A record at your domain registrar and added a CNAME record using the target value from your FlexiFunnels domain settings, and your domain now loads.

Following our guidance, you deleted a second record for the www version and added a CNAME record for www with the same target value, and you confirmed both the main domain and the www version now load your funnel.
We explained that the padlock for the secure certificate can take some time to appear after connecting.
We will check that your secure certificate has been issued and message you if it has not, the morning after our call.
